text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I visited a shrine with Durandal for 
a change of pace, as she had been feeling 
a bit under the weather lately—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Oh? Is that over there—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"What a coincidence, Believe-san. Are 
those... rags and a brush in that bag?"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...I noticed the guardian lion dog was 
dirty, so...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, you went out of your way to help 
clean up? What a wonderful attitude!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...It was nothing. I simply could not 
overlook a masterpiece of true 
craftsmanship being soiled.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if you'd let me lend a hand as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Komainu are sacred beasts that protect the 
gods. I cannot simply abandon it.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Please, feel free.
choice_data_list:
Then let's go ask the head priest for 
permission!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Just gently polish it, and... Phew, how 
does that look?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"...There's still quite a bit of dirt 
left. Maybe it'll come off if I scrub it 
with all my might."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"Don't use brute force! You'll scratch it, 
or at worst, chip the stone."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's true. What was I thinking...? 
...Oh?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Incredible...! Everywhere Believe-san 
polished is sparkling clean. How did you 
get the stains out?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...It's water with baking soda dissolved 
in it. It's very effective for removing 
stains from stone.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
You came well prepared, didn't you? If 
it's alright, would you mind lending me 
some as well?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...I do not mind.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I will definitely clean every 
single nook and cranny. ...As a fellow 
servant to the Lord.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Both knights and komainu are guardians 
serving a master. Thus, we must always 
keep ourselves clean and pure."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Because I am closest to your side, it is 
simply out of the question for me to dress 
in a manner that diminishes my master's 
dignity.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
No dirt upon one's face, not a speck of 
dust upon one's clothes. Such is the 
proper demeanor of one who has sworn 
loyalty.
choice_data_list:
...Alright! Let's keep at it until you're 
completely satisfied!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
And finally, rinse with water... Hehe, you 
look remarkably clean now, Believe-san!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. I think I did a good job 
too.
choice_data_list:
That's the result of you two being so 
particular about it!

That's the result of you two putting so 
much care into it!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it is of satisfactory beauty. ...With 
this, I can proudly protect my Master.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it was thanks to accumulating 
virtue by polishing the komainu statue. 
Durandal managed to regain her good 
condition.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, we visited the shrine office to 
ask the head priest for permission to 
clean up, but—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Kuh, what a tragedy... To think they 
aren't even here...!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
It wouldn't be right to polish it without 
asking... Guess I'll have to come back 
another time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She wasn't able to clean the komainu 
statue. Perhaps because of that, 
Durandal's condition did not recover...
